meta.note: Buy prices are provisional June-2026 snapshots; the first live Actions fetch re-executes each holding at the real market price and recomputes shares. P&L is REALIZED mark-to-market as time passes — NOT a forecast of the 6-month number. Not financial advice.

holdings.name: Sky Gold & Diamonds
holdings.thesis: B2B jewellery scaling with India's market formalisation; ROCE ~30%, no pledge, sales +77% YoY.
holdings.invalidation: Net debt rising not falling, OCF persistently weak, anchor-customer loss, or pledge appearing.

holdings.name: Skipper Ltd
holdings.thesis: India's largest transmission-tower maker; grid-capex super-cycle, no pledge, PAT +63% Q4.
holdings.invalidation: Order inflow stalling, OCF negative, D/E > 1.0, pledge, or surveillance entry.

holdings.name: Elecon Engineering
holdings.thesis: Asia's top industrial-gear maker; debt-free, ROCE ~25%, multi-sector capex tailwind.
holdings.invalidation: Order-inflow decline 2 quarters, OPM -300bps, ROCE < 18%, pledge, or close below 200-DMA.

holdings.name: Cyient DLM
holdings.thesis: EMS growing ~30% CAGR; record order book (B2B 1.46), ROCE ~10% targeted to ~25% — high risk/upside.
holdings.invalidation: ROCE not improving over 4-6 quarters, book-to-bill < 1.0, WC ballooning, or a dilutive raise.

holdings.name: Time Technoplast
holdings.thesis: World #2 composite cylinders (CNG/H2/LPG) + #1 plastic drums; cheap (~22x), debt trending down.
holdings.invalidation: ROCE stalling < 14%, value-added mix not improving, debt rising, or WC deteriorating.
